records.a: task: classify land cover types classify land cover in the jlj region using landsat 5 imagery from 1989. it applies cloud masking via pixel_qa bit extraction, computes ndvi and ndwi indices, and trains an svm classifier using labeled training samples (water, vegetation, urban, paddy, farm, unused, beach). the classification is performed on a mosaic of atmospherically corrected images, resulting in a labeled map with seven classes. accuracy assessment is conducted using a confusion matrix, with outputs including overall accuracy, user's accuracy, producer's accuracy, and kappa coefficient. the final classified raster is exported to google drive.

records.b: task: identify burn severity using dnbr the workflow assesses wildfire burn severity in the karabaglar region using pre- and post-fire sentinel-2 imagery from july and august 2021. it computes the normalized burn ratio (nbr) for both periods, calculates the difference (dnbr), classifies burn severity into eight classes (e.g., high, moderate, low, unburned), and generates a classified raster map. outputs include visualizations of true/false color composites, nbr layers, dnbr in greyscale and classified form, a legend for dnbr classes, and an area summary table reporting pixel counts, hectares, and percentages per severity class. the final classified dnbr map is clipped to a sub-region (geometry2) and exported to google drive.

records.b: task: compute modis ndvi-based vci drought index compute the vegetation condition index (vci) from modis ndvi time series (2001–2003 and 2001–2024) to assess agricultural drought severity. it calculates pixel-wise vci using min/max ndvi normalization, classifies drought severity into seven categories (extreme to no drought), generates a median vci map and a mode-based drought classification map for the full time series, exports the final drought classification raster to google drive, and produces a histogram and area-weighted drought class summary chart over the administrative boundary intersecting a point in iran (52.92°e, 33.57°n).

records.a: task: classify land use with random forest the workflow performs land use and land cover classification using landsat 8 surface reflectance data, generating classified maps for six cities in fujian province (ningde, fuzhou, putian, quanzhou, xiamen, zhangzhou) based on training samples and a random forest classifier. it computes vegetation indices (ndvi, mndwi, lswi, rvi), incorporates srtm-derived elevation and slope, evaluates classification accuracy through confusion matrices and kappa statistics, visualizes variable importance, and exports classified raster images to google drive. additionally, it quantifies the area of specific land cover types such as spartina alterniflora, mangroves, phragmites australis, and soil within each region.
records.b: task: classify land use with random forest the workflow performs land use and land cover classification using landsat 8 surface reflectance data, generating classified maps for six cities in fujian province (ningde, fuzhou, putian, quanzhou, xiamen, zhangzhou) in 2016. it computes vegetation and water indices (ndvi, mndwi, lswi, rvi), incorporates srtm elevation and slope data, trains a random forest classifier on labeled samples, validates accuracy using confusion matrices, and exports classified raster maps to google drive. additionally, it quantifies the area of specific land cover types such as spartina alterniflora, mangroves, phragmites australis, and soil by masking and counting pixels per region.

records.a: task: extract river centerlines and measure width analyze surface water extent and morphology in a specific region using mndwi derived from landsat imagery between 2002 and 2021. it computes annual water masks by combining landsat-based composites (landsat 7 and 8) with the jrc global surface water dataset, applies morphological thinning using the zhang-suen algorithm to extract river centerlines, and calculates metrics including mean water width, connectivity, and sinuosity over time. outputs include masked water extent rasters, centerline rasters, time-series scatter charts of width, connectivity, and sinuosity, and exports for both water extent and centerline images.
records.b: task: extract river centerlines and measure width analyze surface water extent and morphology over time using mndwi derived from landsat imagery (2002–2021). it computes annual water masks by combining landsat 7/8 composites with the jrc global surface water dataset, applies morphological thinning (zhang-suen algorithm) to extract river centerlines, and calculates metrics including mean width, sinuosity, and connectivity. outputs include annual water extent rasters, centerline maps, time-series scatter charts of hydrological metrics, and exports for further analysis.

records.a: task: classify land cover types classify land cover types in the jlj region using landsat 5 imagery from 2006. it applies cloud masking via pixel qa bits (bit 5 for cloud, bit 3 for cloud shadow), computes ndvi and ndwi indices, and trains an svm classifier using training samples from seven classes: water, vegetation, urban, paddy, farm, unused land, and beach. the output includes a classified raster map with six land cover categories, accuracy assessments (confusion matrix, overall accuracy, kappa coefficient, user’s and producer’s accuracy), and exports the classified image to google drive.
records.b: task: classify land cover types classify land cover types in the jlj region using landsat 5 imagery from 1992. it applies cloud masking via pixel_qa bit extraction, computes ndvi and ndwi indices, and trains an svm classifier using labeled training samples (water, vegetation, urban, paddy, farm, unused, beach). the output includes a classified raster map with seven classes, accuracy assessments (confusion matrix, overall accuracy, kappa coefficient), and exports the classification result to google drive.

records.a: task: analyze dam eutrophication trends analyze long-term changes in water body area, chlorophyll-a concentration, and eutrophication percentage in dams from 1987 to 2021 using multi-sensor satellite data. it computes ndwi for water extraction, estimates chlorophyll-a via a band ratio model, and calculates the proportion of eutrophic areas over time, generating time-series charts for area, chl-a, and eutrophication percentage.
records.b: task: analyze reservoir eutrophication trends analyze long-term changes in water body area, chlorophyll-a concentration, and eutrophication percentage for a specific point location using multi-sensor satellite data from 1987 to 2021. it computes ndwi for water extraction, estimates chlorophyll-a via a band ratio model, and calculates the proportion of eutrophic areas within the water body over time, generating time-series charts for area, chl-a, and eutrophication percentage.
